result = action(['UP', 'RIGHT'])

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in 'MRbN' and n['pixels'] >= 10:
        b = n['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in b)
        max_c = max(p[1] for p in b)
        if min_r < 50:
            print(f"{n['color']} at [{min_r},{min_c}]-[{max_r},{max_c}], px={n['pixels']}")

lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in range(16, 30):
    row = lines[r][10:50]
    if any(c in row for c in 'MRbNwg'):
        print(f"r{r}: {row}")
</parameter>
</function>
